name: feicai-studio
description: FEICAI Studio - AI 驱动的影视短剧制作工作台
author: FEICAI

scripts.dev: npm run assets:monaco && node scripts/native-deps.mjs ensure-electron && electron-vite dev
scripts.preview: npm run assets:monaco && node scripts/native-deps.mjs ensure-electron && electron-vite preview
scripts.pack: npm run assets:icons && npm run build && electron-builder --dir
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run build && npm run type-check
scripts.smoke:automation: node scripts/native-deps.mjs ensure-node && vitest run src/main/engine/pipeline-runtime-manager.test.ts src/shared/project-task-validation.test.ts src/shared/project-task-settings.test.ts src/main/project/project-config-store.test.ts
scripts.smoke:batch: node scripts/native-deps.mjs ensure-node && vitest run src/renderer/pages/batch-planner.test.ts src/main/engine/pipeline-runtime-manager.test.ts src/main/engine/pipeline-runtime-manager.integration.test.ts
scripts.smoke:release: npm run assets:icons && npm run build && node scripts/release-preflight.mjs
scripts.qa:batch: npm run smoke:batch && npm run smoke:reports && npm run smoke:automation
